diagnostics.message: Missing description for security group: Security group explicitly uses the default description. Add descriptions for all security groups (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0099)
Missing description for security group rule: Security group rule does not have a description. Add descriptions for all security groups rules (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0124)

Security groups should not allow unrestricted ingress to SSH or RDP from any IP address: Security group rule allows unrestricted ingress from any IP address. Set a more restrictive CIDR range (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0107)

Security groups should not allow unrestricted ingress to SSH or RDP from any IP address: Security group rule allows unrestricted ingress from any IP address. Set a more restrictive CIDR range (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0107)
S3 Access block should block public ACL: No public access block so not blocking public acls. Enable blocking any PUT calls with a public ACL specified (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0086)
S3 Access block should block public policy: No public access block so not blocking public policies. Prevent policies that allow public access being PUT (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0087)
S3 Bucket Logging: Bucket has logging disabled. Add a logging block to the resource to enable access logging (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0089)
S3 Data should be versioned: Bucket does not have versioning enabled. Enable versioning to protect against accidental/malicious removal or modification (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0090)
S3 Access Block should Ignore Public ACL: No public access block so not blocking public acls. Enable ignoring the application of public ACLs in PUT calls (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0091)

S3 Access block should restrict public bucket to limit access: No public access block so not restricting public buckets. Limit the access to public buckets to only the owner or AWS Services (eg; CloudFront) (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0093)

S3 buckets should each define an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block: Bucket does not have a corresponding public access block. Define a aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block for the given bucket to control public access policies (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0094)
S3 encryption should use Customer Managed Keys: Bucket does not encrypt data with a customer managed key. Use SSE-KMS with a customer managed key (CMK) (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0132)
S3 Buckets not publicly accessible through ACL: Bucket has a public ACL: "public-read". Don't use canned ACLs or switch to private acl (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0092)

RDS Cluster and RDS instance should have backup retention longer than default 1 day: Instance has very low backup retention period. Explicitly set the retention period to greater than the default (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0077)
RDS encryption has not been enabled at a DB Instance level: Instance does not have storage encryption enabled. Enable encryption for RDS instances (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0080)
Enable Performance Insights to detect potential problems: Instance does not have performance insights enabled. Enable performance insights (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0133)

RDS IAM Database Authentication Disabled: Instance does not have IAM Authentication enabled. Modify the PostgreSQL and MySQL type RDS instances to enable IAM database authentication. (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0176)
RDS Deletion Protection Disabled: Instance does not have Deletion Protection enabled. Modify the RDS instances to enable deletion protection. (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0177)
RDS Publicly Accessible: Instance has Public Access enabled. Remove the public endpoint from the RDS instance. (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0180)
Lambda functions should have X-Ray tracing enabled: Function does not have tracing enabled. Enable tracing (https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/aws-0066)
